_comment: Packages allowed despite a missing or GPL-family licence. Only the project owner adds entries. Each entry: ecosystem (cargo|npm), name, optional version, the exact licence string it approves, reason, approved_by, approved_on (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry without approved_by does not count.

allow.name: khroma
allow.reason: MIT. The bundled licence file (node_modules/khroma/license) is the standard MIT text, 'Copyright (c) 2019-present Fabio Spampinato, Andrew Maney'; only package.json lacks a licence field. Pulled in by mermaid via streamdown (desktop Markdown renderer).
